units.source_text: 不知怎的，后来祖父竟高兴得声泪俱下。

en.t: For some reason, Grandfather later became so happy that he was moved to tears.

units.source_text: （像美代这样一个贫苦的佃农人家，还能收到许多家的祝贺，祖父替她高兴。）

en.t: For a poor tenant farming family like Miyo's to receive congratulations from so many households made Grandfather happy for her.
